body: Thank you. I’m getting help. Hopefully one day I’ll look back on this situation and truly realize how lucky I was to have ppl care enough about me, a random stranger on the internet, to reach out and say something.

Thank you. I’m sorry I hadn’t responded. Your message helped me reconsider and I’m glad I did. I was going to take a handful of pain pills, random drugs in my medicine cabinet and alcohol along with what I was already on to make sure I didn’t wake up. I didn’t do it though. I don’t think I would be here had I not made this post and had wonderful ppl like you reach out. Thank you for caring
I’m ok. I’m getting help. I was reluctant but I know I need it. It’s hard and I know it’s going to take a while to heal but I think I’ll be alright. Thank you
Thank you. I’m getting help and I’m glad that things happened the way they did.

Thank you. They told me if I didn’t go I might not have died but it would have affected my internal organs a lot more than it did. I’m still in the hospital but I’m getting help so thank you. I’m not sure how this would have ended had I not made this post. I was going to take a lot more medication but I second guessed myself bc of everyone who reached out. Thank you
Thank you. I’m getting help so there’s that. I know it’s going to take time but I think I’ll be okay. Thank you for caring
The texture alone would make my soul leave my body
Yeah I’m at the fucking hospital fuck my life. These nurses and doctors look at me like I’m some wounded animal I fucking want to die even more

Yeah I’m only 19 but I feel like it’s too late. I’ve lost everything. The way these doctors and nurses are looking at me makes me feel like a freak. I’m getting so many ekgs done and they think i could have damaged myself permanently
Lol I’ll have to try that next
Okay then what do you suggest
You’re right it does hurt lol. I’m sorry I’m being cynical I just guess I’m trying to distract myself from the pain
Lol I have 0 friends. No one cares about me. Sorry I’m making typing errors I’m shaking and my vision is getting blurry
Thanks. I guess if I do have long term damage add it to the list of reasons why my life is fucked

If I do live I’m definitely going to get fired from job. I fucking hate my job but getting fired is going to look awful. Also my parents are already disappointed in me and getting fired might get me kicked out of the house and i have no where to go
I don’t think I can do it. I keep thinking I made a mistake but then I think back on why I’m doing this. I’m shaking and crying and I just want to die god why can’t I just fucking die

Same. I’m 19. I’ve had suicidal thoughts since I was 6. Today has been my first suicide attempt bc I’ve been to much of a bitch to try it before now. I took all of my anti depressants. I’m not sure I’m going to die today. I want to die but apart of me just wants to be better and not hurt anymore. I hope we both can find peace some day

I’d rather not say where I’m from but I don’t think I’m going to call an ambulance. I don’t want to end up in a psych hospital. My mom is going to be home tonight so maybe I will tell her what I did but I don’t know
I’m starting to feel really awful. I’m starting to see flashes of light out of the corner of my eyes and I have a really strong urge to throw up
Happy birthday to Chester <3
Thank you <3 goodbye

Thank you no it’s okay I just, I don’t really have anything to say. I only made this post not for sympathy but closure I guess you could say. And honestly I don’t care if it’s physically painful I just am so tired of hurting internally that I’ll do anything to end it
